findings.title: ensureAllVendorSections reads config.toml with try? ?? empty string; an unreadable config would be rewritten with only default sections
findings.evidence: (try? String(contentsOf:)) ?? "" then appends defaults and saves (raised by Ferreiro, remediation B14)
findings.fix: Distinguish file-not-found from a read failure; on any other read error throw instead of rewriting
findings.impact: A transient read failure (permissions, encoding) could replace user edits with defaults
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B14

findings.title: VendorViewModel.refresh(now:) uses the injected now only for loadingSince; the rate-limit cooldown still reads Date.now
findings.evidence: Two clocks in one function (raised by Higia, remediation B14)
findings.fix: Use the injected now for the cooldown check as well
findings.impact: Tests cannot drive the cooldown; the parameter name overstates its use
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B14

findings.title: FetchError.guidance is not persisted in .last_error; a relaunch rebuilds the error without guidance
findings.evidence: DiskCache.lastError() rebuilds FetchError(status:body:) only (raised by Jano, remediation B14; Nemesis notes the stale tooltip currently only reads the in-memory error)
findings.fix: Persist guidance as an optional third line and read the old two-line format; or confirm no persisted path reaches the UI and pin that with a test
findings.impact: Possible English guidance text on a cold-start stale card in pt-BR/es
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B14

findings.title: AnalyticsEstimatesMergeTests.weeklySummaries waits a fixed 100 ms before awaiting historyReloadTask
findings.evidence: Fixed Task.sleep (raised by Higia, remediation B14); sibling of TEST-MAE-005
findings.fix: Await the store completion signal instead of sleeping
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B14
